subject.title: fix: silent credential-save failures and session/tool hygiene gaps

question: Should temporary executable resource installs remain private and ephemeral per run, or become a persistent cache under the agent directory?
rationale: The current patch improves cross-user permissions but changes the resource lifecycle and trust persistence; tests cannot establish the intended security and cleanup contract.

options.title: Private ephemeral staging
options.body: Create a private per-run directory with deterministic cleanup so downloaded executable resources do not survive beyond their temporary lifecycle.

options.title: Explicit persistent cache
options.body: Retain the agent-directory location only with named cache semantics, invalidation, cleanup, stale-code handling, and user-visible repair behavior.

recommendation.title: Private ephemeral staging
recommendation.body: Create a private per-run directory with deterministic cleanup so downloaded executable resources do not survive beyond their temporary lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans the affected agent runtime, session/tool, and install-topology boundaries.
